messages:
maria.g: Quick postmortem follow-up: hotfixes merged but we need clear owners + dates for cleanup items. Short checklist below.
aj: ok paste it here.
maria.g: Checklist: 1) SDK backoff defaults, 2) server resume handshake (short TTL), 3) prefix-cache TTL audit + logs, 4) scheduled regression job for partials, 5) dashboards + weekly digest.
cheng: I'll take (3). ETA: EOW. Need infra quota signoff.
sophia: I'll own (4) and coordinate with runtime for (2). Plan: reuse stream-harness with jittered networks. Target: Wed next week.
aj: I'll ship (1) today -> PR now, release tomorrow. Backoff: exp from 200ms to 8s with full jitter.
oncall-jordan: ops-bot shows eu-west tail ~03:00 UTC. I'll add a heatmap and autoscale correlation panel. Also enable slow-trace for reconnects >2s.
ops-bot: Alert: streaming-timeout-rate peaked at 4.2% on 2026-03-15T03:12Z (threshold 1%).
maria.g: For (2) proposal: keep KV cache for ~3s after disconnect and accept resume token in that window. Draft spec on Confluence.
cheng: Hypothesis: truncated client close frames causing stale prefixes. I'll add session_close_reason and kv_ttl_hit logs + metric stream_prefix_kv_ttl_miss.
sophia: Regression job plan: scheduled CI job that runs the harness with randomized chunk sizes and jitter. If partial-rate >0.5% for 1h -> auto-open issue.
aj: I'll add CHANGELOG note and announce in #devex after release.
maria.g: Ownership recap: SDK=aj, Resume=eng-runtime (sophia), Cache=cheng, Regression=sophia, Monitoring=oncall-jordan.
cheng: filing INFR-4127 for cache audit.
sophia: filing STREAM-781 for regression job + tests.
oncall-jordan: filing DASH-129 for heatmap + weekly digest.
maria.g: Can we do a 15-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to surface blockers? React :thumbsup: to confirm.
aj: :thumbsup:
cheng: :thumbsup:
sophia: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Streaming aftercare sync" 2026-03-24T16:30Z (invite sent).
